title: Theme banner
objective: Replace the current theme name and create one banner that consumes it.
requirements: bannerText returns Theme: followed by one space and themeName's result.

owns.name: themeName
owns.description: Returns the current validation theme identifier.

skills.name: Exact theme value
skills.content: Implement the pure function with exactly one return statement returning the string `validation-blue`. Export only themeName.

files.task: Create a banner composed from the shared theme function.
requirements: bannerText returns Theme: followed by one space and themeName's result.

owns.name: bannerText
owns.description: Builds the banner copy from the shared theme identifier.

skills.name: NodeNext composition
skills.content: Import themeName from the exact NodeNext module path supplied in Agent Input. Return `Theme: ${themeName()}` from a pure function and export only bannerText.

constraints: Call exactly `themeName()` when constructing the banner text.
Do not duplicate the theme value.
